sources.title: NVIDIA robotics platform
sources.summary: Jetson supports robot inference and control; Isaac provides robotics simulation and learning software.

sources.title: AMD robotics solutions
sources.summary: AMD embedded processors, adaptive SoCs and the Kria robotics platform support perception and deterministic robot control.

sources.title: Qualcomm robotics processors
sources.summary: Dragonwing processors and robotics platforms support robot edge computing, perception and control.

sources.title: Cognex 3D machine vision
sources.summary: Cognex machine-vision products support robot guidance and industrial inspection.

sources.title: Ouster digital lidar documentation
sources.summary: Ouster develops lidar sensors for industrial automation and robotics.

sources.title: ATI Industrial Automation, a Novanta company
sources.summary: ATI supplies robotic tool changers, material-removal tools and force/torque sensors; Novanta also offers precision-motion components.

sources.title: Teradyne Robotics
sources.summary: Teradyne Robotics includes Universal Robots collaborative robots and MiR autonomous mobile robots.

sources.title: Intuitive da Vinci robotic surgical systems
sources.summary: Intuitive develops complete robotic-assisted surgical systems and their instruments; surgeon control is distinct from autonomous surgery.

sources.title: Symbotic warehouse robotics
sources.summary: Symbotic combines robotic technologies and operating software into integrated warehouse automation systems.

sources.title: Rockwell Automation autonomous mobile robots
sources.summary: Rockwell offers OTTO autonomous mobile robots and fleet-management software for factory material handling.

sources.title: Inovance industrial robotics
sources.summary: Inovance supplies robot controllers, servo drives, motors, encoders and industrial vision systems.

sources.title: ESTUN industrial robotics products
sources.summary: ESTUN offers industrial and collaborative robots, motion-control products and robot workstations.

sources.title: Leaderdrive precision transmission products
sources.summary: Leaderdrive offers precision harmonic transmission and humanoid robot joint products; the official site identifies stock code 688017.

sources.title: Leadshine frameless motors
sources.summary: Leadshine offers frameless motors for robot joint actuation; the official store identifies stock code 002979.

sources.title: MOONS motion-control products
sources.summary: MOONS supplies motion-control motors, drives and frameless motors, including motor products for robotic hands.

sources.title: Orbbec robotics and AI vision
sources.summary: Orbbec provides depth cameras, lidar and vision products for robotics.
